name: erp_vendor_bills_list
description: List vendor bill transactions (AP), optionally filtered by payment status, approval status or vendor entity (GET /services/rest/record/v1/vendorBill)

status.description: Bill payment status filter: open or paid.

approval_status.description: Approval routing status filter (approvalStatus): pendingApproval, approved or rejected.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (default 30).
